title: tithymalus cerebrinus
intro: Tithymalus cerebrinus, commonly known as Euphorbia peplus, is a small annual plant native to Europe and Western Asia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as its potential to treat skin conditions like warts and other minor skin irritations due to its ability to stimulate the immune system. The plant's therapeutic actions include its use as a topical agent to induce skin cell death, thus eliminating warts, as well as its potential to be used in the treatment of various types of cancer. The bioactive constituents of Tithymalus cerebrinus include phorbol esters, which have been found to have anti-cancer and anti-viral properties.
